DDInter743.mechanism: Concomitant use of avatrombopag with moderate to potent dual inhibitors of CYP450 2C9 and 3A4 may increase the systemic exposure (AUC) to avatrombopag. This may lead to an increased risk of avatrombopag toxicities including thromboembolic events such as portal vein thrombosis and septic thrombophlebitis. Metabolic clearance via CYP450 2C9 appears be more significant than CYP450 3A4. In addition, pooled pharmacogenomic analysis of avatrombopag studies suggests that CYP450 2C9 polymorphisms may also impact the clearance of avatrombopag.
